svg.title: Build, package, verify locally, distribute, and verify again
svg.desc: Create one canonical skill, package its supported capabilities, verify locally before publication, distribute a reviewed version, then verify installed discovery, invocation, results, and unchanged input. A working local fixture is not proof that the published installation behaves identically.

text.tspan: Trust checks apply before every new executable version.
